Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Punta Mita so unique?

The Punta Mita offer untouched natural beauty with dramatic cliffs, waterfalls, and remote fjords. They blend Nordic culture with rich traditions and warm hospitality.

What types of accommodations do you offer in Punta Mita?

We offer a range of stays including cozy cabins, seaside cottages, and luxury lodges. Each accommodation is handpicked for its comfort, charm, and stunning location. Whether you seek solitude or adventure, we have the perfect place for you.

Can I expect privacy at your Punta Mita properties?

Yes, we prioritize your privacy. Whether you’re staying in a secluded villa or a luxurious resort, each of our properties is designed to offer a peaceful and private retreat, allowing you to unwind and enjoy the beauty of the Island without distractions.

When is the best time to visit the Punta Mita?

The best time to visit is from May to September when the weather is milder and the days are longer. You’ll experience lush green landscapes, birdwatching, and cultural events. This period offers the most accessible travel and outdoor adventures.

Is it easy to travel around the Punta Mita?

Yes, the islands are well-connected by roads, tunnels, ferries, and bridges. Car rentals are popular and offer the most flexibility for exploring. Public buses and inter-island ferries also run on regular schedules.

How accurate is the pricing shown for a particular property?

We strive to show accurate pricing for a property based on the lowest nightly rate we have been able to find for a property. For the most accurate pricing, please input your date range and search for the property. You will be referred over to the partner or the property owner's own website to confirm the specific pricing. We are working on functionality to find you the best price across multiple websites for the property you are interested in. Stay tuned as we refine this feature.
